title: UG-049 — How to use the complexity indicator
intent: Explain what the complexity indicator shows and why it matters.
short_answer: The complexity indicator shows how complex the questionnaire is. Adding many elements or visibility settings increases complexity. If complexity is too high, the published questionnaire can become slow for participants.
important_conditions: Reduce complexity by simplifying the questionnaire, limiting dependencies, and avoiding unnecessarily complex structures.
related_articles: UG-042 — Keep surveys short and simple
